text_block_list.name: Group of Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go! One, two! One,<n>two!

The runners' chants are drowned out<n>by the sound
of their footsteps. Each<n>of them is working hard
every single<n>day in pursuit of their dreams.

We've set our sights on the Asahi<n>Hai F.S. as our
next goal, but, being a<n>G1 race, it's tough to even
qualify.

However, given Biwa Hayahide's<n>potential, we're
not worried.

As long as she keeps gaining<n>experience and
improving...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're here too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'm not one to speak. I'm<n>here to watch
her too. It's impossible<n>not to get drawn in by her
running.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...She's always been fascinating to<n>watch, since
ages back.
I turn to see where she's looking.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Raaah! I'm gonna beat you today, for<n>sure!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh, be quiet.

Standing on the track is Hishi<n>Amazon, the
hot-blooded leader of<n>Miho Dormitory. She's still
awaiting<n>her debut.

And next to her is Biwa Hayahide's<n>younger sister,
the Umamusume<n>who's captured everyone's
attention—Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. C'mon, you can afford to<n>loosen up a bit.
How far are we<n>racin', anyway?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: 1,600 meters.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A mile, huh? That's unexpected. Any<n>reason for
picking that particular<n>distance?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Because I wanna run the whole thing<n>full tilt. I crave
that speed—I need to go<n>all out!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Planning to leave me in the dust right<n>from the
get-go, huh? Hah! Bring it!<n>This is gonna be one
helluva race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Referee
text_block_list.text: Are you both ready? On your marks!<n>Get set...
It's an amazing race.

They compete against each other with<n>an almost
feral ferocity. Everyone's<n>eyes are glued to the
intense action.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Come on, Hishiama! You can do it,<n>Brian!
But then, in the final stretch of the<n>race...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Gasp!
Whoooosh!

Narita Brian unleashes a terrifying<n>burst of speed
that slices through the<n>noise of the crowd, leaving
the<n>spectators silent.

An unsettling feeling washes over me<n>as I wonder
what would happen if<n>Narita Brian and Biwa
Hayahide were<n>to compete...

Even if Hayahide chased after her at<n>full speed,
would she ever be able to<n>catch up?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, if you say so. But that was<n>quite the intense
look you had on.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It was the same face I made long<n>ago...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I know how you feel. Here, let me<n>make use of
what I experienced<n>before and put your feelings
into<n>words.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian is an Umamusumeworthy of one day being called thebest.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Only fools would try to compete with<n>her in light of
her extraordinary talent.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was that foolish once as a child. One<n>moment I
was running free, the next,<n>I'd been overtaken. I
was scared of<n>losing, so I panicked...
Crash!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I tried to catch up with her... and<n>that's when I got
hurt.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Lying in that hospital bed, I had<n>nothing but time to
think. And that's<n>when—
choice_data_list:
That's when you started working nonstop on your
winning equation, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's right. And now I work onit with a strange trainer who tookmore interest in my potential than mysister's.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We might actually be the biggest fools<n>in the whole
world.
HAYAHIDEEE!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh. I think this is as far as our talk<n>is going to
get.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hello, Ticket. And you, too, Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Sometimes I wish this wild childcame with an off switch.

Narita Taishin is Biwa Hayahide's<n>friend who just
debuted this year.<n>Her slight frame belies her ability
to<n>run at unimaginable speed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You seriously need to learn to read<n>the room.
Couldn't you see they<n>were talking?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Well, I mean, I saw Hayahide, so ofcourse I had to come and say hi!

Winning Ticket is an energetic<n>Umamusume and
one of Biwa<n>Hayahide's classmates. I've heard<n>the
three of them are close friends.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Plus, there's something I absolutelyhave to say! I don't know if yourealized, but all three of us...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Have made our debut!Congratulations t-to sob... everyooone! Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Okay, but why are you crying?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, never mind—hurry it up. Don't<n>you have
something else to say?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, that's right! Sorry! Okay,<n>since we're
all here, why don't we<n>go on a run?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: We can do 2,400 meters, just like<n>that one time!
choice_data_list: What time are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A time from ages ago. When we first<n>started here,
we had to measure our<n>times for class, and Ticket
had the<n>idea to run 2,400 meters for it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Because the Derby is 2,400<n>meters long!
choice_data_list: (She must be talking about the Japanese Derby...)

text_block_list.text:
Umamusume can only take part in this<n>prestigious
race once in their lives.<n>It's an honor every racer
aspires to.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Normally, new students only run 1,000<n>meters, but...
we all just went for it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Who do you think?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The three of us! And after that, we<n>started doing
everything together.<n>Hehe, those were great times.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's right! So Let's recreate it—just<n>like this!
RAAAGGGHHH!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait up! Where are you going,<n>dummy?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Aaand they're off. Mind if I join<n>them?
choice_data_list: Go. And don't you dare lose!
Go. And don't you dare lose!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You know I won't!

She runs off in pursuit of Winning<n>Ticket and Narita
Taishin.

I wonder how much longer times like<n>these will
last...
The next day, I hear a rumor.

Apparently, Narita Taishin and<n>Winning Ticket will be
entering the<n>Hopeful Stakes, a junior G1 race.

It's not the same as the Asahi Hai<n>F.S. that Biwa
Hayahide will be<n>entering, but it's still a G1... And
it's<n>the highest junior level race.

It would appear that Narita Brian isn't<n>the only
fierce rival out there.
